intervention: Diets including oat beta-glucan, a soluble fibre in oats and barley
summary: Oats contain beta-glucan, a soluble fibre that lowers LDL cholesterol. Across 58 trials the average drop was about 0.19 mmol/L (about 7 mg/dL): a real but modest effect.
whyThisGrade: Many trials used foods enriched with extra oat beta-glucan

foods.note: The food table lists total fibre. Beta-glucan itself isn't measured.

studies.title: The effect of oat β-glucan on LDL-cholesterol, non-HDL-cholesterol and apoB for CVD risk reduction: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised-controlled trials
